// diagnostic E0447

Jet.SemicolonWithoutLineBreak

A `;` can't stand here, because a line break here would not end the statement

What

A `;` can't stand here, because a line break here would not end the statement

Why

A `;` means exactly a line break, so it stands only where a line break would end the statement; here the next line would continue this one, or nothing before it is a statement to end.

Fix

Remove the `;`, or finish the statement before it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SemicolonWithoutLineBreak: Tests/UI/semicolon_without_line_break.stderr.
